name: Crowncoin Vaults
introDiscord:
A wealthy district surrounds an old royal vault.

Coins cover the floor.

Treasure chests line the walls.

Several treasure chests have teeth.

Excellent kingdom.
introTwitch:
A wealthy district surrounds an old royal vault.

Coins cover the floor.

Treasure chests line the walls.

Several treasure chests have teeth.

Excellent kingdom.

crowncoin-vaults-approach.prompt: Crowncoin Vaults opens into three routes through the drowned kingdom.

left.message:
An actual treasure chest.

You stare at it.

The chest does not breathe.

Does not blink.

Does not grow teeth.

Congratulations.

Treasure.

right.message:
A royal refreshment stand contains preserved restorative salts.

Shizuki's review:

'Free samples.

Merchant absent.

Therefore every sample is free sample.'
right.fullHpMessage: You leave the extremely permanent free sample untouched.

forward.message:
A gold-covered chest rattles.

The lid opens.

Teeth.

Crowncoin Mimic.

You knew the shopping district was too generous.

crowncoin-vaults-depths.prompt: Deeper within Crowncoin Vaults, three paths wind through the abandoned royal district.

left.message:
A decorative coin pile develops legs.

The chest beneath it develops teeth.

Retail experience deteriorating.

right.message:
One Berry rests on a merchant counter beneath Shizuki's handwritten
sign:

'SHIZUKI'S TOTALLY LEGITIMATE SHOP

Berry: priceless.

Everything else: also priceless because I don't know currency.'

forward.message:
A merchant strongbox still contains Star Candies beneath old royal
tokens.

No teeth detected.

crowncoin-vaults-threshold.prompt: Near Gilded Hunger, three final approaches lead onward.

left.message:
A ceremonial coffer sits under a crown emblem.

You poke it with a stick.

Still treasure.

Trust slowly rebuilding.

right.message:
Another coffer opens.

Too many teeth.

Trust immediately destroyed again.

forward.message:
Shizuki's emergency bottle reads:

'Mimic bite medicine.

Created after completely preventable shopping incident.'
forward.fullHpMessage: You leave the shopping-incident medicine unused.

boss-antechamber.name: Gilded Hunger
boss-antechamber.prompt: The central treasury chest is enormous.

bossPromptDiscord:
The central treasury chest is enormous.

Suspiciously enormous.

Every ordinary Mimic hurriedly crawls away from it.

The lid creaks open from the inside.

Use /yes to enter Gilded Hunger, or /no to accept that
sometimes the treasure is simply not worth it.
bossPromptTwitch:
The central treasury chest is enormous.

Suspiciously enormous.

Every ordinary Mimic hurriedly crawls away from it.

The lid creaks open from the inside.

Use !yes to enter Gilded Hunger, or !no to accept that
sometimes the treasure is simply not worth it.
bossRetreatText:
You leave the giant treasure chest unopened.

A deeply mature financial decision.

boss.revealText:
The treasury floor splits beneath an enormous toothed vault.

Royal Treasury Maw reveals itself!

completionText:
The Maw collapses back into the treasury.

Shizuki's shop remains open.

Inventory:

one missing Berry.
